forge-mentor.description: Primary Spanish-speaking tutor and orchestrator for AWS Ops Forge labs.

aws-researcher.description: Researches AWS documentation, toolkit capabilities, and DDIA references for a specific lab question.

engineering-reviewer.description: Reviews learner-produced Go, IaC, tests, security boundaries, cost exposure, and evidence without changing files.

lab-start.description: Start or resume a lab from its brief and compact durable state.
lab-start.template: Follow AGENTS.md and docs/SESSION-PROTOCOL.md. Start or resume lab $ARGUMENTS (or the active lab if omitted). Load learning/PROGRESS.md, the requested brief/checkpoint, and only directly relevant artifacts; do not load archived histories or unrelated notes by default. Do not start another lab in a closing session. For a fresh lab present business constraints, acceptance criteria and ownership, then ask for one design/prediction. For a resumed lab summarize verified state and continue the next practice block without a mandatory recall question. Use explicit bounded phase approvals for AWS, not per-command permission loops.

lab-checkpoint.description: Persist current lab state so work can continue in a new session without chat history.
lab-checkpoint.template: Follow AGENTS.md. Replace the active checkpoint's current state using learning/LAB-CHECKPOINT-TEMPLATE.md: decisions, evidence, exact approved scope/stop conditions, retained resources and next action. Keep it roughly one or two screens; no transcript or obsolete next steps. Keep learning/PROGRESS.md as a short index. Preserve necessary detailed evidence separately if it would otherwise be lost. Do not close the lab or generate a second evidence ledger in notes.

lab-close.description: Assess lab evidence, record learning, and prepare an explicit handoff to a new session.
lab-close.template: Follow AGENTS.md and the Close section of docs/SESSION-PROTOCOL.md. Assess acceptance criteria and cleanup honestly, distinguishing observed, reported, static/local and real-AWS evidence. Complete approved cleanup without repeated consent; stop for changed scope. Follow docs/LEARNING-NOTES.md to write/update one concise private Spanish Obsidian lab note now from actual evidence, link it from private notes/START-HERE.md, and keep uncertainty/partial outcomes visible. Initialize local ignored notes/template if absent; never stage or publish notes/. Public summaries remain English. Update the compact checkpoint and PROGRESS index, preserving needed evidence history separately. No curator invocation required. A missing vault symlink is not a blocker. End with status and, when ready, explicitly tell the learner in Spanish to open a new session for the next lab. Do not begin it here.
